_meta.name: pairwise_correlation_matrix
_meta.description: Pairwise-deletion Pearson correlation matrix of price, income and label on training_data.pulse: params.missing pairwise computes each cell over the rows where both members are present instead of dropping every row with any null member, and adds auxiliary.n (the per-pair row count). A pairwise matrix need not be positive semidefinite, so predict reports pairwise_psd_risk and the run warns PULSE_MATRIX_NOT_PSD when it is not.
